bestFor.text: Searching file contents with regular expressions across a project. It recurses by default and skips .gitignore'd, hidden and binary files, so results stay focused on source.

lookElsewhere.text: You need a portable, POSIX-standard tool that is already on every machine. ripgrep's own README recommends grep for that job.

alternatives.text: Choose ast-grep to match code by syntax (abstract syntax tree nodes) instead of text, for example to find or rewrite a call pattern.
Choose fd to find files and directories by name. It matches file names, not file contents.

bestFor.text: Driving a real browser step by step from shell commands: take an accessibility snapshot, then click or fill elements using the refs it returns.

lookElsewhere.text: You only need a page's content or a single capture. agent-browser works through a sequence of browser commands and downloads Chrome for Testing on first install.

alternatives.text: Playwright CLI also targets coding agents, exposing Playwright through concise commands. Its README points to Playwright MCP instead for long-running loops that need persistent browser context.
Choose shot-scraper for one-command screenshots, video demos, or JavaScript-based scraping of a page.
Firecrawl CLI searches, scrapes, crawls and maps sites through the hosted Firecrawl service, which requires authentication.
